nd193-m01.ten: Contract settlement value calculation sheet between investor and contractor (A-B final settlement)
nd193-m01.dung_khi: Projects using public investment capital, recurrent State budget expenditure or other State budget funds (Article 1, Decree 193/2026/ND-CP; effective from 1 July 2026): the investor and the contractor prepare the A-B final settlement to accompany the dossier submitted for audit and approval of final settlement (Article 7). Not to be confused with Form No. 01/QTDA of Circular 73/2026/TT-BTC (Consolidated final settlement report).

nd193-m02.ten: Written request to the contractor to supplement and complete the project contract final settlement documents
nd193-m02.dung_khi: Projects using public investment capital, recurrent State budget expenditure or other State budget funds (Article 1, Decree 193/2026/ND-CP; effective from 1 July 2026): where the contractor does not carry out the contract final settlement as required, the investor issues a written request to the contractor on the basis of the contract (Clause 5, Article 7). Not to be confused with Form No. 02/QTDA of Circular 73/2026/TT-BTC (List of documents).

nd207-nd-bao-cao-su-co.dung_khi: Within 24 hours of an incident, the investor reports in writing to the provincial People's Committee of the locality where the incident occurred (incidents causing casualties: also send to the Ministry of Construction and the competent authority).

nd207-nd-bien-ban-nghiem-thu-cong-viec.ten: Record of acceptance of construction work items
nd207-nd-bien-ban-nghiem-thu-cong-viec.dung_khi: Acceptance of each work item (or several work items of one component in construction sequence) on site; the supervisor carries out acceptance within no more than 24 hours of receiving the contractor's request.

nd207-nd-bien-ban-nghiem-thu-hoan-thanh.ten: Record of completion acceptance of a construction component or construction work
nd207-nd-bien-ban-nghiem-thu-hoan-thanh.dung_khi: The investor organizes completion acceptance of the construction component or work before it is put into use (including partial acceptance and conditional acceptance - Clauses 2 and 3, Article 24).

nd207-nd-bien-ban-nghiem-thu-vat-lieu.ten: Record of acceptance of materials, products, components and equipment used for the work
nd207-nd-bien-ban-nghiem-thu-vat-lieu.dung_khi: The investor's construction supervisor accepts materials, products, components and equipment before they are used for the work.

nd207-pl11a.ten: Report on extending the service life of a work
nd207-pl11a.dung_khi: The owner or the managing/operating entity of a work that has reached its design service life sends a report on the results of inspection, assessment and strengthening or repair (if any) to the competent State authority to obtain its opinion on extending the service life (Point c, Clause 4, Article 43, Decree 207/2026/ND-CP).

nd207-pl11b.ten: Notice of opinion on extending the service life of a work
nd207-pl11b.dung_khi: The competent State authority (Clause 9, Article 43, Decree 207/2026/ND-CP) issues a written opinion on extending the service life of the work after receiving the report of the owner or the managing/operating entity.
can_cu: Point c, Clause 4 and Clause 9, Article 43, Decree 207/2026/ND-CP

nd207-pl2b.ten: As-built drawings - as-built drawing stamp template
nd207-pl2b.dung_khi: The construction contractor prepares as-built drawings and affixes the as-built drawing stamp (Clause 13, Article 15, Decree 207/2026/ND-CP); Template No. 1 where the main contractor-subcontractor, EPC or turnkey contract form is not applied; Template No. 2 where those forms are applied.

nd207-pl4a.ten: Periodic report on construction supervision of a work or work component
nd207-pl4a.dung_khi: The construction supervision organization or individual prepares a periodic report, or a report by construction stage, and sends it to the investor; the investor specifies in the contract or the assignment decision the reporting period and timing (Point a, Clause 3, Article 20, Decree 207/2026/ND-CP).

nd207-pl4b.ten: Report on completion of construction supervision of a package, stage, work component or work
nd207-pl4b.dung_khi: The construction supervision organization prepares a report on completion of construction supervision of a package, stage, work component or work and sends it to the investor (Clause 3, Article 20, Decree 207/2026/ND-CP).

nd207-pl5.ten: Notice of commencement of construction of a work component or work
nd207-pl5.dung_khi: Before commencing construction, the investor sends a commencement notice, in person, by post or online, to the local State construction management authority (Clause 2, Article 12, Decree 207/2026/ND-CP).

nd207-pl6.ten: Report on completion of construction of a work component or work
nd207-pl6.dung_khi: The investor sends 1 report on completion of construction of the work component or work to the specialized construction agency so that it can inspect the completion acceptance of the work (Point a, Clause 4, Article 27, Decree 207/2026/ND-CP).

nd207-pl8.ten: Notice of results of inspection of completion acceptance of a work component or work
nd207-pl8.dung_khi: The specialized construction agency issues a notice of the results of its inspection of the completion acceptance of the work component or work, clearly stating whether it accepts or does not accept the investor's acceptance results (Point b, Clause 4, Article 27, Decree 207/2026/ND-CP).

nd212-pl3-m01.ten: Application for a construction practice certificate
nd212-pl3-m01.dung_khi: Submitted by an individual with the dossier for a new or re-issued construction practice certificate (Point a, Clause 1, Article 39, Decree 212/2026/ND-CP); for online submission, the information is declared on the electronic form on the National Public Service Portal.
nd212-pl3-m01.nguon: Form No. 01, Appendix III, issued with Decree 212/2026/ND-CP of 17 June 2026 of the Government

nd212-pl3-m02.ten: Application for conversion of a construction practice certificate
nd212-pl3-m02.dung_khi: A foreign individual or an overseas Vietnamese who holds a practice license issued abroad and has practiced in Vietnam for 6 months or more applies to convert the practice certificate (Clause 2, Article 27 and Article 39, Decree 212/2026/ND-CP).
nd212-pl3-m02.nguon: Form No. 02, Appendix III, issued with Decree 212/2026/ND-CP of 17 June 2026 of the Government

nd212-pl3-m04.ten: Application for a construction activity license (contractor being an organization)
nd212-pl3-m04.dung_khi: A foreign contractor that is an organization submits this with the dossier for a construction activity license (Point a, Clause 2, Article 44, Decree 212/2026/ND-CP); the application is prepared in Vietnamese.
nd212-pl3-m04.nguon: Form No. 04, Appendix III, issued with Decree 212/2026/ND-CP of 17 June 2026 of the Government

nd212-pl3-m06.ten: Power of attorney (application for a construction activity license for a foreign contractor)
nd212-pl3-m06.dung_khi: A foreign contractor authorizes a person who is not its legal representative to sign documents, submit the dossier and receive the result of the procedure for a construction activity license (Point e, Clause 2, Article 44, Decree 212/2026/ND-CP).
nd212-pl3-m06.nguon: Form No. 06, Appendix III, issued with Decree 212/2026/ND-CP of 17 June 2026 of the Government

nd212-pl3-m07.ten: Application for a construction activity license (contractor being an individual)
nd212-pl3-m07.dung_khi: A foreign contractor that is an individual submits this with the dossier for a construction activity license (Point a, Clause 2, Article 44, Decree 212/2026/ND-CP); the application is prepared in Vietnamese.
nd212-pl3-m07.nguon: Form No. 07, Appendix III, issued with Decree 212/2026/ND-CP of 17 June 2026 of the Government

nd212-pl3-m11.ten: Application for adjustment of a construction activity license
nd212-pl3-m11.dung_khi: A foreign contractor that has been granted a construction activity license applies for adjustment when its name, address, joint-venture members, subcontractors or other details stated in the license change (Article 45, Decree 212/2026/ND-CP).
nd212-pl3-m11.nguon: Form No. 11, Appendix III, issued with Decree 212/2026/ND-CP of 17 June 2026 of the Government

nd217-pl1-m01.ten: Submission for appraisal of the Feasibility Study Report
nd217-pl1-m01.dung_khi: The project preparation body submits the Feasibility Study Report to the specialized construction agency for appraisal.
nd217-pl1-m01.nguon: Form No. 01, Appendix I, Decree 217/2026/ND-CP (consolidated text 91/2026/VBHN-BXD)

nd217-pl1-m02.ten: Report on the results of verification of construction design in the Feasibility Study Report
nd217-pl1-m02.dung_khi: The contractor verifies and reports the results of verification of the construction design in the Feasibility Study Report (attached to the dossier submitted for appraisal).
nd217-pl1-m02.nguon: Form No. 02, Appendix I, Decree 217/2026/ND-CP (consolidated text 91/2026/VBHN-BXD)

nd217-pl1-m03.ten: Notice of results of appraisal of the Feasibility Study Report by the specialized construction agency
nd217-pl1-m03.dung_khi: The specialized construction agency notifies the results of its appraisal of the Feasibility Study Report.
nd217-pl1-m03.nguon: Form No. 03, Appendix I, Decree 217/2026/ND-CP (consolidated text 91/2026/VBHN-BXD)

nd217-pl1-m04.ten: Request for appraisal of the Economic-Technical Report
nd217-pl1-m04.dung_khi: The project preparation body requests the agency/unit assigned by the investment decision-maker to appraise the Economic-Technical Report.
nd217-pl1-m04.nguon: Form No. 04, Appendix I, Decree 217/2026/ND-CP (consolidated text 91/2026/VBHN-BXD)

nd217-pl1-m05.ten: Request for appraisal of the Feasibility Study Report
nd217-pl1-m05.dung_khi: The project preparation body requests the agency/unit assigned by the investment decision-maker to appraise the Feasibility Study Report.
nd217-pl1-m05.nguon: Form No. 05, Appendix I, Decree 217/2026/ND-CP (consolidated text 91/2026/VBHN-BXD)

nd217-pl1-m06.ten: Notice of results of appraisal of the Economic-Technical Report by the agency/unit assigned by the investment decision-maker (for reference)
nd217-pl1-m06.dung_khi: The agency/unit assigned to carry out the appraisal notifies the results of appraisal of the Economic-Technical Report.
nd217-pl1-m06.nguon: Form No. 06, Appendix I, Decree 217/2026/ND-CP (consolidated text 91/2026/VBHN-BXD)

nd217-pl1-m07.ten: Notice of results of appraisal of the Feasibility Study Report by the agency/unit assigned by the investment decision-maker (for reference)
nd217-pl1-m07.dung_khi: The agency/unit assigned to carry out the appraisal notifies the results of appraisal of the Feasibility Study Report.
nd217-pl1-m07.nguon: Form No. 07, Appendix I, Decree 217/2026/ND-CP (consolidated text 91/2026/VBHN-BXD)

nd217-pl1-m08.ten: Notice of results of appraisal of the Feasibility Study Report by the agency/unit assigned by the investment decision-maker that is also the specialized construction agency (for reference)
nd217-pl1-m08.dung_khi: The agency/unit assigned to carry out the appraisal that is also the specialized construction agency notifies the results of appraisal of the Feasibility Study Report.
nd217-pl1-m08.nguon: Form No. 08, Appendix I, Decree 217/2026/ND-CP (consolidated text 91/2026/VBHN-BXD)

nd217-pl1-m09.ten: Decision approving the project (project requiring a Feasibility Study Report)
nd217-pl1-m09.dung_khi: The investment decision-maker issues the decision approving a project that requires a Feasibility Study Report.

nd217-pl1-m10.ten: Decision approving the project (project requiring only an Economic-Technical Report)
nd217-pl1-m10.dung_khi: The investment decision-maker issues the decision approving a project that requires only an Economic-Technical Report.

nd217-pl1-m11.ten: Report on the results of verification of detailed construction design after project approval
nd217-pl1-m11.dung_khi: The contractor verifies and reports to the investor the results of verification of the detailed construction design after the project has been approved.

nd217-pl1-m12.ten: Notice of results of appraisal of detailed construction design after project approval
nd217-pl1-m12.dung_khi: The agency/unit assigned to carry out the appraisal notifies the investor of the results of appraisal of the detailed construction design after the project has been approved.

nd217-pl1-m13.ten: Decision approving detailed construction design after project approval
nd217-pl1-m13.dung_khi: The approving agency/organization issues the decision approving the detailed construction design after the project has been approved, on the basis of the notice of appraisal results.

nd217-pl1-m14.ten: Stamp templates for appraisal, verification and approval of construction design
nd217-pl1-m14.dung_khi: Stamps affixed to construction design drawings that have been appraised, verified or approved, as confirmation.

nd217-pl1-m15.ten: Notice requesting supplementation and completion of the dossier
nd217-pl1-m15.dung_khi: The specialized construction agency requests the project preparation body to supplement the dossier submitted for appraisal of the Feasibility Study Report.
can_cu: Point a, Clause 3 and Clause 5, Article 36, Decree 217/2026/ND-CP

nd217-pl1-m16.dung_khi: The specialized construction agency suspends the appraisal of the Feasibility Study Report (no more than once) where the dossier contains errors or omissions that make it impossible to reach an appraisal conclusion.

nd217-pl1-m17.ten: Decision issuing an emergency construction order
nd217-pl1-m17.dung_khi: The investment decision-maker issues an emergency construction order for an emergency construction project or work.

nd217-pl2-m01.ten: Application for a new building permit
nd217-pl2-m01.dung_khi: Submitted by the investor with the dossier for a new building permit, a phased building permit, for a project, a detached house, or for repair, renovation or relocation of a work (for a temporary building permit, the title of the application changes under Clause 2, Article 62).

nd217-pl2-m02.ten: Application for adjustment/extension/re-issuance of a building permit
nd217-pl2-m02.dung_khi: Submitted by the investor to request adjustment, extension or re-issuance of an issued building permit (a request for re-issuance must state the reason).

nd217-pl2-m03.ten: New building permit / adjusted or extended building permit
nd217-pl2-m03.dung_khi: The building permit issuing authority issues a new building permit (or records an adjustment or extension) to the investor.

nd217-pl2-m04.ten: Permit for repair, renovation or relocation of a work
nd217-pl2-m04.dung_khi: The building permit issuing authority issues a permit for repair, renovation or relocation of a work (or records an adjustment or extension) to the investor.

nd217-pl2-m05.dung_khi: The building permit issuing authority issues a temporary building permit for a work or detached house (or records an adjustment or extension).

nd217-pl2-m06.ten: Stamp template of the building permit issuing authority
nd217-pl2-m06.dung_khi: The building permit issuing authority stamps the design drawings attached to the building permit issued to the investor (when electronic signatures are not used).

nd254-m02a.ten: Contract information summary sheet (where performed under a contract)
nd254-m02a.dung_khi: Prepared by the investor on the basis of a contract that has taken effect and sent to the payment authority in the legal dossier for first transactions or when changes, adjustments or additions arise (Point d, Clause 1, Article 8).
nd254-m02a.nguon: Form No. 02.a/TT, Forms System Appendix to Decree 254/2025/ND-CP of 26 September 2025 of the Government

nd254-m02b.ten: Cost estimate information summary sheet (where not performed under a contract)
nd254-m02b.dung_khi: Prepared by the investor on the basis of the approved cost estimate for work not performed under a contract, and sent to the payment authority in the legal dossier (Point dd, Clause 1, Article 8).
nd254-m02b.nguon: Form No. 02.b/TT, Forms System Appendix to Decree 254/2025/ND-CP of 26 September 2025 of the Government

nd254-m02c.ten: Compensation, support and resettlement information summary sheet
nd254-m02c.dung_khi: Prepared by the investor or the unit/organization carrying out compensation, support and resettlement on the basis of the approved plan, and sent to the payment authority in the legal dossier (Point e, Clause 1, Article 8).
nd254-m02c.nguon: Form No. 02.c/TT, Forms System Appendix to Decree 254/2025/ND-CP of 26 September 2025 of the Government

nd254-m03a.ten: Sheet determining the value of completed work volumes
nd254-m03a.dung_khi: Prepared each time payment is requested for completed work volumes (including recovery of advance payments), together with the Request for Payment of Capital and the Withdrawal Request (Clause 3, Article 8; Clause 5, Article 9).
nd254-m03a.nguon: Form No. 03.a/TT, Forms System Appendix to Decree 254/2025/ND-CP of 26 September 2025 of the Government
can_cu: Points a and b, Clause 3 and Clause 6, Article 8

nd254-m03b.ten: Statement of the value of compensation, support and resettlement work carried out
nd254-m03b.dung_khi: Prepared each time payment is requested for compensation, support and resettlement, together with the Request for Payment of Capital and the Withdrawal Request (Sub-point (i), Point b, Clause 3, Article 8).
nd254-m03b.nguon: Form No. 03.b/TT, Forms System Appendix to Decree 254/2025/ND-CP of 26 September 2025 of the Government

nd254-m04a.dung_khi: Sent by the investor/PMU to the payment authority each time an advance payment or payment for completed work is requested (Clauses 2 and 3, Article 8).
nd254-m04a.nguon: Form No. 04.a/TT, Forms System Appendix to Decree 254/2025/ND-CP of 26 September 2025 of the Government

nd254-m04b.dung_khi: Prepared by the investor when requesting recovery of capital already advanced (converting the advance into actual expenditure) or converting an advance made ahead of plan that did not yet meet payment conditions into an advance that meets payment conditions, together with the payment dossier (Clause 3, Article 8).
nd254-m04b.nguon: Form No. 04.b/TT, Forms System Appendix to Decree 254/2025/ND-CP of 26 September 2025 of the Government
can_cu: Points a and b, Clause 3 and Clause 6, Article 8

nd254-m04c.ten: Request for recovery of capital advanced ahead of plan
nd254-m04c.dung_khi: Prepared by the investor to recover capital advanced ahead of plan once the annual public investment plan has been assigned (Clause 7, Article 8).
nd254-m04c.nguon: Form No. 04.c/TT, Forms System Appendix to Decree 254/2025/ND-CP of 26 September 2025 of the Government

nd254-m05a.dung_khi: Sent by the investor to the payment authority together with the Request for Payment of Capital in the advance payment dossier and the payment dossier (Clauses 2 and 3, Article 8).
nd254-m05a.nguon: Form No. 05.a/TT, Forms System Appendix to Decree 254/2025/ND-CP of 26 September 2025 of the Government

nd254-m08a.ten: Consolidated report on advance payments and recovery of advances (of the investor, or the unit/organization carrying out compensation, support and resettlement)
nd254-m08a.dung_khi: Each quarter, the investor (before the 5th) and the unit/organization carrying out compensation, support and resettlement (before the 3rd of the first month of the following quarter) report on advance payments and recovery of advances for each project (Point b, Clause 6, Article 9).
nd254-m08a.nguon: Form No. 08.a/SDTƯ, Forms System Appendix to Decree 254/2025/ND-CP of 26 September 2025 of the Government

nd254-m09.ten: Project management cost allocation sheet for requesting payment to clear project management cost advances
nd254-m09.dung_khi: Prepared by an investor or PMU directly managing several projects to allocate project management costs when requesting payment or recovery of advances of project management costs (Clause 6, Article 8; Point c, Clause 5, Article 9).
nd254-m09.nguon: Form No. 09/QLDA, Forms System Appendix to Decree 254/2025/ND-CP of 26 September 2025 of the Government

tt36-b11.ten: Preliminary summary of total construction investment
tt36-b11.dung_khi: Preliminary summary of total construction investment when preparing the pre-feasibility study report and the investment policy proposal (Article 3, Part I of Appendix I). Applies to the entities specified in Article 2 of Decree 206/2026/ND-CP; Circular 36/2026/TT-BXD takes effect on 1 July 2026.

tt36-b12.dung_khi: Summary of total construction investment when preparing the construction investment feasibility study report (Article 4, Part II of Appendix I). Applies to the entities specified in Article 2 of Decree 206/2026/ND-CP; Circular 36/2026/TT-BXD takes effect on 1 July 2026.

tt36-b21.ten: Summary of construction work cost estimate
tt36-b21.dung_khi: Summary of the construction work cost estimate under formula (2.1) of Appendix II (Article 6). Applies to the entities specified in Article 2 of Decree 206/2026/ND-CP; Circular 36/2026/TT-BXD takes effect on 1 July 2026.

tt36-b22.dung_khi: Summary of equipment costs in the construction work cost estimate under formula (2.2) of Appendix II (Article 6). Applies to the entities specified in Article 2 of Decree 206/2026/ND-CP; Circular 36/2026/TT-BXD takes effect on 1 July 2026.

tt36-b24.dung_khi: Summary of construction consultancy costs in the construction work cost estimate (Article 6; Clause 4, Section 1 of Appendix II). Applies to the entities specified in Article 2 of Decree 206/2026/ND-CP; Circular 36/2026/TT-BXD takes effect on 1 July 2026.

tt36-b25.dung_khi: Summary of other costs in the construction work cost estimate under formula (2.6) of Appendix II (Article 6). Applies to the entities specified in Article 2 of Decree 206/2026/ND-CP; Circular 36/2026/TT-BXD takes effect on 1 July 2026.

tt36-b26.ten: Summary of construction package cost estimate
tt36-b26.dung_khi: Summary of the construction package cost estimate (Article 7). Applies to the entities specified in Article 2 of Decree 206/2026/ND-CP; Circular 36/2026/TT-BXD takes effect on 1 July 2026.

tt36-b27.ten: Summary of construction work item cost estimate
tt36-b27.dung_khi: Summary of the construction work item cost estimate (Clause 4, Article 76, Construction Law No. 135/2025/QH15; Article 8, Circular 36/2026/TT-BXD). Applies to the entities specified in Article 2 of Decree 206/2026/ND-CP; Circular 36/2026/TT-BXD takes effect on 1 July 2026.

tt36-b31.dung_khi: Summary of the construction costs of a work under Appendix III (method of determining construction costs) when preparing the cost estimate (Article 6). Applies to the entities specified in Article 2 of Decree 206/2026/ND-CP; Circular 36/2026/TT-BXD takes effect on 1 July 2026.

tt36-b38.ten: Summary of construction cost estimate (determined by quantities and construction unit prices)
tt36-b38.dung_khi: Summary of the construction cost estimate where construction costs are determined by quantities and construction prices as guided in Points 2.1 and 2.2 of Appendix III. Applies to the entities specified in Article 2 of Decree 206/2026/ND-CP; Circular 36/2026/TT-BXD takes effect on 1 July 2026.
tt36-b38.nguon: Table 3.8, Appendix III, Circular 36/2026/TT-BXD (checked against corrective Decision 1538/QD-BXD)

tt36-b39.ten: Summary of construction cost estimate (direct costs based on lump-sum quotations)
tt36-b39.dung_khi: Summary of the construction cost estimate for work items, parts or components that require a separate design or specialized technology or construction methods, where direct costs are determined from lump-sum quotations of a qualified entity (Appendix III). Applies to the entities specified in Article 2 of Decree 206/2026/ND-CP; Circular 36/2026/TT-BXD takes effect on 1 July 2026.
tt36-b39.nguon: Table 3.9, Appendix III, Circular 36/2026/TT-BXD (checked against corrective Decision 1538/QD-BXD)

tt36-b41.ten: Calculation sheet for the price of materials delivered to the site
tt36-b41.dung_khi: Calculation of the price of materials delivered to the site where the investor or consultant determines construction work prices itself under Appendix IV because the issued or published prices and norms are unavailable or unsuitable (Clause 3, Article 12). Applies to the entities specified in Article 2 of Decree 206/2026/ND-CP; Circular 36/2026/TT-BXD takes effect on 1 July 2026.
tt36-b41.nguon: Table 4.1, Appendix IV, Circular 36/2026/TT-BXD (checked against corrective Decision 1538/QD-BXD)

tt36-b42.ten: Summary of construction work item prices
tt36-b42.dung_khi: Summary of construction work item prices (material, labor and construction machinery costs for each work item) where the investor or consultant determines prices itself under Appendix IV because the issued or published prices and norms are unavailable or unsuitable (Clause 3, Article 12). Applies to the entities specified in Article 2 of Decree 206/2026/ND-CP; Circular 36/2026/TT-BXD takes effect on 1 July 2026.

tt36-b43.ten: Summary of construction work group prices
tt36-b43.dung_khi: Summary of construction work group prices from the prices of individual construction work items where the investor or consultant determines prices itself under Appendix IV (Clause 3, Article 12). Applies to the entities specified in Article 2 of Decree 206/2026/ND-CP; Circular 36/2026/TT-BXD takes effect on 1 July 2026.
tt36-b43.nguon: Table 4.3, Appendix IV, Circular 36/2026/TT-BXD (checked against corrective Decision 1538/QD-BXD)

tt36-b54.ten: Summary of construction survey cost estimate
tt36-b54.dung_khi: Summary of the construction survey cost estimate, since construction survey costs are determined by an estimate as guided in Appendix V (Point c, Clause 1, Article 14). Applies to the entities specified in Article 2 of Decree 206/2026/ND-CP; Circular 36/2026/TT-BXD takes effect on 1 July 2026.
tt36-b54.nguon: Table 5.4, Appendix V, Circular 36/2026/TT-BXD (checked against corrective Decision 1538/QD-BXD)

tt36-pl7-m01.ten: Announcement of monthly/quarterly construction material prices in the province/city
tt36-pl7-m01.dung_khi: The Department of Construction announces construction material prices monthly/quarterly in its locality using the template in Appendix VII; enterprises use it to look up and compare against announced material prices. Applies to the entities specified in Article 2 of Decree 206/2026/ND-CP; Circular 36/2026/TT-BXD takes effect on 1 July 2026.

tt36-pl7-m02.ten: Announcement of annual construction labor prices in the province/city
tt36-pl7-m02.dung_khi: The Department of Construction announces construction labor prices annually in its locality using the template in Appendix VII; enterprises use it to look up and compare against announced labor unit prices. Applies to the entities specified in Article 2 of Decree 206/2026/ND-CP; Circular 36/2026/TT-BXD takes effect on 1 July 2026.

tt36-pl7-m03.ten: Announcement of construction machinery and equipment shift prices in the province/city
tt36-pl7-m03.dung_khi: The Department of Construction announces construction machinery and equipment shift prices in its locality using the template in Appendix VII (Point b, Clause 5, Article 11); enterprises use it to look up and compare against announced machine shift prices. Applies to the entities specified in Article 2 of Decree 206/2026/ND-CP; Circular 36/2026/TT-BXD takes effect on 1 July 2026.
tt36-pl7-m03.nguon: Form No. 03, Appendix VII, Circular 36/2026/TT-BXD (checked against corrective Decision 1538/QD-BXD)

tt36-pl8-m01.ten: Report on the results of verification of total construction investment
tt36-pl8-m01.dung_khi: The consultant verifies and reports to the project preparation body the results of verification of the total construction investment where an independent verification of total investment is requested. Applies to the entities specified in Article 2 of Decree 206/2026/ND-CP; Circular 36/2026/TT-BXD takes effect on 1 July 2026.

tt36-pl8-m02.ten: Notice of results of appraisal of total construction investment by the specialized construction agency
tt36-pl8-m02.dung_khi: The specialized construction agency notifies the project preparation body of the results of appraisal of the total construction investment where an independent appraisal of total investment is requested. Applies to the entities specified in Article 2 of Decree 206/2026/ND-CP; Circular 36/2026/TT-BXD takes effect on 1 July 2026.

tt36-pl8-m03.ten: Notice of results of appraisal of total construction investment by the agency assigned by the investment decision-maker to lead the appraisal
tt36-pl8-m03.dung_khi: The agency/unit assigned by the investment decision-maker to carry out the appraisal notifies the project preparation body of the results of appraisal of the total construction investment where an independent appraisal of total investment is requested. Applies to the entities specified in Article 2 of Decree 206/2026/ND-CP; Circular 36/2026/TT-BXD takes effect on 1 July 2026.

tt36-pl8-m04.ten: Report on the results of appraisal of total construction investment for projects with FEED design or technical design in the Feasibility Study Report, and projects requiring only an Economic-Technical Report
tt36-pl8-m04.dung_khi: The investor reports to the investment decision-maker (or the appraisal-leading agency under the investment decision-maker) the results of appraisal of the total construction investment for projects with FEED design or technical design in the Feasibility Study Report, and projects requiring only an Economic-Technical Report. Applies to the entities specified in Article 2 of Decree 206/2026/ND-CP; Circular 36/2026/TT-BXD takes effect on 1 July 2026.

tt36-pl8-m05.ten: Report on the results of verification of construction work cost estimate
tt36-pl8-m05.dung_khi: The consultant verifies and reports to the investor the results of verification of the construction work cost estimate where an independent verification of the construction work cost estimate is requested. Applies to the entities specified in Article 2 of Decree 206/2026/ND-CP; Circular 36/2026/TT-BXD takes effect on 1 July 2026.

tt36-pl8-m06.ten: Notice of results of appraisal of construction work cost estimate by the specialized construction agency for works under sub-projects or components using public investment capital in PPP projects
tt36-pl8-m06.dung_khi: The specialized construction agency notifies the investor of the results of appraisal of the construction work cost estimate for works under sub-projects or components using public investment capital in a PPP project, where an independent appraisal of the cost estimate is requested. Applies to the entities specified in Article 2 of Decree 206/2026/ND-CP; Circular 36/2026/TT-BXD takes effect on 1 July 2026.

tt36-pl8-m07.ten: Report on the results of appraisal of construction work cost estimate
tt36-pl8-m07.dung_khi: The agency/unit within the investor assigned to carry out the appraisal notifies the results of appraisal of the construction work cost estimate where an independent appraisal of the cost estimate is requested. Applies to the entities specified in Article 2 of Decree 206/2026/ND-CP; Circular 36/2026/TT-BXD takes effect on 1 July 2026.

tt40-b1.ten: Summary of construction work maintenance costs
tt40-b1.dung_khi: Determination and summary of construction work maintenance costs, comprising upkeep and repair costs and other work items in the maintenance plan (Article 2, Circular 40/2026/TT-BXD; effective from 1 July 2026).
tt40-b1.nguon: Table 1, Appendix I, issued with Circular 40/2026/TT-BXD

tt40-b21.ten: Summary of work upkeep cost estimate
tt40-b21.dung_khi: Preparation and summary of the work upkeep cost estimate (Article 3, Appendix II, Circular 40/2026/TT-BXD; effective from 1 July 2026).
tt40-b21.nguon: Table 2.1, Appendix II, issued with Circular 40/2026/TT-BXD

tt40-b25.dung_khi: Preparation of the upkeep execution cost estimate (direct costs, indirect costs, estimated taxable income, VAT, temporary facilities) under Section II of Appendix II, Circular 40/2026/TT-BXD; effective from 1 July 2026.
tt40-b25.nguon: Table 2.5, Appendix II, issued with Circular 40/2026/TT-BXD

tt40-b31.ten: Summary of work repair cost estimate
tt40-b31.dung_khi: Preparation and summary of the construction work repair cost estimate (Article 4, Appendix III, Circular 40/2026/TT-BXD; effective from 1 July 2026).
tt40-b31.nguon: Table 3.1, Appendix III, issued with Circular 40/2026/TT-BXD

tt40-b32.dung_khi: Preparation of the work repair execution cost estimate (direct costs, indirect costs, estimated taxable income, VAT, temporary facilities) under Section II of Appendix III, Circular 40/2026/TT-BXD; effective from 1 July 2026.
tt40-b32.nguon: Table 3.2, Appendix III, issued with Circular 40/2026/TT-BXD

tt73-m01.ten: Consolidated report on project investment capital final settlement
tt73-m01.dung_khi: A project (component project, sub-project, independent work or work component) that is completed, or a terminated project with accepted construction and equipment installation volumes (Clause 1, Article 4, Circular 73/2026/TT-BTC; effective from 1 July 2026).

tt73-m02.dung_khi: A project (component project, sub-project, independent work or work component) that is completed, or a terminated project with accepted construction and equipment installation volumes (Clause 1, Article 4, Circular 73/2026/TT-BTC; effective from 1 July 2026).

tt73-m03.dung_khi: Used both for completed/terminated projects with volumes (Clause 1, Article 4) and for planning, investment preparation or terminated projects without volumes (Clause 2, Article 4, Circular 73/2026/TT-BTC); reconciled with the payment authority.

tt73-m04.ten: Details of investment costs proposed for final settlement
tt73-m04.dung_khi: A project (component project, sub-project, independent work or work component) that is completed, or a terminated project with accepted construction and equipment installation volumes (Clause 1, Article 4, Circular 73/2026/TT-BTC; effective from 1 July 2026).

tt73-m05.ten: Details of the value of assets formed
tt73-m05.dung_khi: A project (component project, sub-project, independent work or work component) that is completed, or a terminated project with accepted construction and equipment installation volumes (Clause 1, Article 4, Circular 73/2026/TT-BTC; effective from 1 July 2026).

tt73-m06.ten: Details of the value of surplus materials, supplies and equipment
tt73-m06.dung_khi: A project (component project, sub-project, independent work or work component) that is completed, or a terminated project with accepted construction and equipment installation volumes (Clause 1, Article 4, Circular 73/2026/TT-BTC; effective from 1 July 2026).

tt73-m07.dung_khi: Used both for completed/terminated projects with volumes (Clause 1, Article 4) and for planning, investment preparation or terminated projects without volumes (Clause 2, Article 4, Circular 73/2026/TT-BTC).

tt73-m08.ten: Project investment capital final settlement report (planning, investment preparation, or terminated projects without volumes)
tt73-m08.dung_khi: Planning projects, investment preparation projects, or terminated projects with no accepted construction and equipment installation volumes (Clause 2, Article 4, Circular 73/2026/TT-BTC).

tt73-m10.ten: Decision approving investment capital final settlement (of a project, component project, independent sub-project, independent work or work component)
tt73-m10.dung_khi: The agency leading the audit prepares the draft decision approving the final settlement as part of the dossier submitted to the competent approving authority (Clause 4, Article 4, Circular 73/2026/TT-BTC; Clause 1, Article 19, Decree 193/2026/ND-CP).

tt73-m11.ten: Annual report on the final settlement of projects using public investment capital
tt73-m11.dung_khi: Ministries, central agencies, State-owned groups and corporations, provincial People's Committees (and subordinate units, commune-level People's Committees) report on the final settlement of projects using public investment capital during the year (Clause 5, Article 4, Circular 73/2026/TT-BTC; Article 22, Decree 193/2026/ND-CP).

tt73-m12.ten: Receipt for handover of the project investment capital final settlement dossier
tt73-m12.dung_khi: The investor/PMU hands the final settlement dossier directly to the agency leading the audit; the dossier receipt time counts from when representatives of both parties sign the receipt (Point a, Clause 6, Article 4, Circular 73/2026/TT-BTC).

tt79-dt01.ten: Consultancy and project management cost calculation sheet (prepared separately for each project)
tt79-dt01.dung_khi: An investor or PMU with a project using State budget funds (Article 1, Circular 79/2026/TT-BTC; effective from 1 July 2026) determines the revenue from costs it carries out for each project assigned to it, as the basis for preparing the revenue estimate (Article 6) and the dossier submitted for appraisal and approval of the annual estimate (Article 9).

tt79-dt02.dung_khi: An investor or PMU with a project using State budget funds (Article 1, Circular 79/2026/TT-BTC; effective from 1 July 2026) prepares the annual salary calculation sheet for each employee involved in project management, as the basis for preparing the revenue and expenditure estimate (Clause 5, Article 5) and the dossier submitted for approval of the annual estimate (Article 9).

tt79-dt03.ten: Annual project management revenue and expenditure estimate
tt79-dt03.dung_khi: An investor or PMU with a project using State budget funds (Article 1, Circular 79/2026/TT-BTC; effective from 1 July 2026) prepares the annual revenue and expenditure estimate (Clause 3, Article 7) and submits it for appraisal and approval (Article 9); the PMU prepares and implements the annual estimate (Article 12).

tt79-qd01.ten: Decision approving the annual project management revenue and expenditure estimate of a Group I PMU
tt79-qd01.dung_khi: The head of the agency or unit assigned as investor approves the planning-year revenue and expenditure estimate of the investor or Group I PMU no later than 31 December of the year preceding the planning year (Point b, Clause 4, Article 9, Circular 79/2026/TT-BTC).

tt79-qd02.ten: Decision approving the annual project management revenue and expenditure estimate of a Group II PMU
tt79-qd02.dung_khi: The director of a Group II PMU (a public non-business unit) approves the PMU's annual revenue and expenditure estimate (Article 12, Circular 79/2026/TT-BTC); the approved estimate is sent to the superior managing agency and the financial agency of the same level.

tt79-qdqt01.ten: Decision approving the annual project management revenue and expenditure final settlement of the investor or a Group I PMU
tt79-qdqt01.dung_khi: The head of the investor agency approves the annual revenue and expenditure final settlement of the investor or Group I PMU within a maximum of 15 working days from receipt of a valid and complete annual final settlement report dossier (Clauses 2, 5 and 7, Article 10, Circular 79/2026/TT-BTC).

tt79-qdqt02.ten: Decision approving the annual project management revenue and expenditure final settlement of a Group II PMU
tt79-qdqt02.dung_khi: The financial agency of the same level audits and approves the annual revenue and expenditure final settlement of a Group II PMU within a maximum of 15 working days from receipt of a valid and complete annual final settlement report dossier (Clause 4, Article 13, Circular 79/2026/TT-BTC).

tt79-qt01.ten: Annual project management revenue and expenditure final settlement report of the investor or a Group I PMU
tt79-qt01.dung_khi: After the planning year ends, the investor or Group I PMU obtains the confirmation of the payment authority in order to prepare the revenue and expenditure final settlement report no later than 28 February of the following year (Clause 1, Article 10, Circular 79/2026/TT-BTC).
can_cu: Clause 1 and Point b, Clause 4, Article 10, Circular 79/2026/TT-BTC

tt79-qt02.ten: Annual project management revenue and expenditure final settlement report of a Group II PMU
tt79-qt02.dung_khi: A Group II PMU (a public non-business unit) prepares the annual revenue and expenditure final settlement report within the annual final settlement report dossier sent to the financial agency of the same level for audit and approval (Article 13, Circular 79/2026/TT-BTC).
can_cu: Point b, Clause 1 and Clause 3, Article 13, Circular 79/2026/TT-BTC
